subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Silence can make problems feel private and shameful.”?
options: It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.
It needs to be clear, honest, and followed by better care next time.
Reading became less lonely when students could leave thoughts for the next reader.
A school that speaks openly gives students permission to care for their minds.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It needs to be clear, honest, and followed by better care next time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Reading became less lonely when students could leave thoughts for the next reader.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Silence can make problems feel private and shameful. A school that speaks openly gives students permission to care for their minds.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Silence can make problems feel private and shameful. A school that speaks openly gives students permission to care for their minds.」，答案為「A school that speaks openly gives students permission to care for their minds.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A school that speaks openly gives students permission to care for their minds.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
